conditions: Inertial rod of constant proper length, aligned with its relative motion; endpoint positions measured simultaneously in the observing frame. Relative speed v satisfies 0<=v<c, with gamma the Lorentz factor.
spoken_aliases: l equals l sub zero divided by gamma
length in the observing frame equals proper length divided by the lorentz factor

evidence: Use the inverse Lorentz transformation x'=gamma(x-vt), with the rod stationary in the primed frame. Observing both endpoints at equal unprimed time gives delta x'=gamma delta x. Their rest separation is L0, while delta x=L in the observing frame, hence L=L0/gamma.
Reference checked 2026-11-27: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-3/pages/5-key-equations. Proposed maintainer approval, not independent human certification.
